notes: VCA300: Buyer Print Due List — a buyer card taller than the page no longer gets chopped. Cards are now built as per-day groups; a card that fits a column still prints whole (best-fit packing), but an oversized card splits at day boundaries and FLOWS into the next column(s) to the right, each continuation banner marked '— தொடர்ச்சி' (continued). Fixes the wide-date-range (e.g. 15-day) print overrun.
